newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shares in electric wire firms jump in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Shares in electric wire firms jump in Tokyo.

text.p: Shares in electric wire manufacturers jumped on Monday morning, as buying interest in telecommunications shares extended to related issues, brokers said.
Fujikura Ltd shares jumped 14 yen to 961 yen at 0112 GMT, Sumitomo Electric Industries Ltd gained 20 yen to 1,630 yen and Mitsubishi Cable Industries Ltd rose eight yen to 608 yen.
Showa Electric Wire and Cable Co Ltd nudged up two yen to 567 yen by 0035 GMT, after rising briefly to 573 yen.

Brokers said Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp's (NTT) recent solid earnings drew attention to the telecommunications sector. Cable makers attracted attention due to hopes of further development in optical cables, they said.
